name: Minecraft
description: Makes a Minecraft-style blocky voxel animation for a reel. A cottage builds itself block by block on a grassy hill, about 165 blocks dropping in with a bounce, then the chimney slams in with a puff of dust, the windows light up warm, smoke rises and a big pixel-font word lands. Procedural 16x16 pixel textures, blocky trees and flat blocky clouds, rendered with three.js.
style: Minecraft-style blocky voxel animation: a cottage builds itself block by block on a grassy hill, about 165 blocks dropping in with a bounce, then the chimney slams in with a puff of dust, the windows light up warm, smoke rises and a big pixel-font word lands. Procedural 16x16 pixel textures, blocky trees and flat blocky clouds, rendered with three.js. Lowercase pixel-font captions; the build line drops in letter by letter and the one-word payoff slams in with the chimney.
